Prices for the stay of Nov 4 to 6, 2026, as listed on September 30, 2026.

17 Siem Reap hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 30, 2026 for Nov 4 to Nov 6, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Siem Reap hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Siem Reap hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Priceline at 3, the hotel's own site at 3, Booking.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Evendo at 1 and Trip.com at 1. These are the Siem Reap rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 12 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Priceline at 3, the hotel's own site at 3, Trip.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Booking.com at 1, Evendo at 1 and Hotelscombined.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 5, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Across all cities: which booking site was lowest most often, measured.

Taxes and fees at Siem Reap hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 12% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at HARI Residence & Spa to 22% at Eightfold Urban Resort. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
